source: measured natively on Bitwig 6.1.4; no parameter values
general: Grid pitch signal: 0 = MIDI 60, 0.1 per octave (1 semitone = 1/120).
A Poly Grid voice ends immediately unless something affects voice lifetime (Note In with Affect Voice Lifetime, or an envelope with lifetime on).

Grid value writes (parameters, voicing, remote pages) and modulator parameter writes work while playing; module and cable edits need the transport stopped. Recording or automation write on blocks every write.
A Grid with a module whose required inputs are unsatisfied can be dropped from the audio network silently (Bitwig log: 'component nitro should be rejected from the network').

Sine: PITCH_IN is scaled by PITCH_MOD (default 0 = no effect; raw 1.0 = 120 semitones).
Sawtooth: PITCH_IN is scaled by PITCH_MOD (default 0 = no effect; raw 1.0 = 120 semitones).
Pulse: PITCH_IN is scaled by PITCH_MOD (default 0 = no effect; raw 1.0 = 120 semitones).
Triangle: PITCH_IN is scaled by PITCH_MOD (default 0 = no effect; raw 1.0 = 120 semitones).
Phasor: PITCH_IN is scaled by PITCH_MOD (default 0 = no effect; raw 1.0 = 120 semitones).
Note In: Affect Voice Lifetime keeps a Poly Grid voice alive.
Fine with no connections: it still sets the voice lifetime.
AD: With GATE on it does not retrigger from short trigger pulses: use GATE off for trigger-driven envelopes.
ADSR: With GATE on it does not retrigger from short trigger pulses: use GATE off for trigger-driven envelopes.
Long Delay: TIME 0.025 = shortest (usable as a 1-sample feedback delay).
TIME raw = cbrt(seconds), and it is ignored while UNIT is a note value (default 16th): set UNIT Seconds.
Mod Delay: TIME is ignored while UNIT is a note value (default 16th): set UNIT Seconds.
Steps: DEVICE_PHASE defaults to On and then ignores a cable on PHASE_IN; set DEVICE_PHASE off to drive it from a phase signal.
Pitches: DEVICE_PHASE defaults to On and then ignores a cable on PHASE_IN; set DEVICE_PHASE off to drive it from a phase signal.
Gates: DEVICE_PHASE defaults to On and then ignores a cable on PHASE_IN; set DEVICE_PHASE off to drive it from a phase signal.
MODE has Gate, Pulse and Trigger options.
Probabilities: DEVICE_PHASE defaults to On and then ignores a cable on PHASE_IN; set DEVICE_PHASE off to drive it from a phase signal.
Accents: DEVICE_PHASE defaults to On and then ignores a cable on PHASE_IN; set DEVICE_PHASE off to drive it from a phase signal.
Slopes: DEVICE_PHASE defaults to On and then ignores a cable on PHASE_IN; set DEVICE_PHASE off to drive it from a phase signal.
Triggers: STEPS=N fed by a phase produced 2N rising edges per cycle.
DEVICE_PHASE defaults to On and then ignores a cable on IN; set DEVICE_PHASE off to drive it from a phase signal.
Comb: Resonant pitch = CUTOFF raw + 120 * CUTOFF_MOD * MOD_IN + KEYTRACK * (note - 60) (semitones); CUTOFF_MOD is linear (display st = 120 * raw).
Negative POLARITY keeps the same fundamental with odd harmonics only (it is not an octave down).
DAMPING >= 0.5 keeps the pitch within +-0.05 st over MIDI 45-81.
SVF: KEYTRACK defaults to 100%: in a Poly Grid the cutoff follows the played note (about 2 octaves darker than written for a C1 note); set KEYTRACK 0 for a fixed cutoff.

devicePhase.message: has a cable on its phase input but DEVICE_PHASE is on, so the cable is ignored; set DEVICE_PHASE off

keytrack.message: has KEYTRACK {value} in a Poly Grid, so its cutoff follows the played note; set KEYTRACK 0 for a fixed cutoff

rawNonLinear.message: {parameter} raw {raw} is on a non-linear scale and displays {effective}; write {example} to set a display value

rawTiny.message: {parameter} raw {raw} is on a cube-root Hz scale and displays {effective}, effectively no detune; write {example} or a raw of 0.5 or more

unitIgnoresTime.message: TIME is ignored while UNIT is a note value ({unit}); set UNIT {{"label":"Seconds"}} to use a time in seconds

retriggerOff.message: has GATE_IN connected but RETRIGGER is off, so the phase is not reset per hit (clicks, inconsistent transients); set RETRIGGER on

deadEnd.message: has connected inputs but none of its outputs is used
